description: Send a quotation request by email to Unan Trading (tolga@unantrading.com) on the buyer's behalf. The email cannot be recalled once sent; the same request repeated within 24 hours is not sent again. It goes only to Unan Trading, never to other addresses. Unan Trading replies by email within one business day. Use it only after the buyer has seen the exact details (name, company, email, products and quantities) and asked you to send them; set buyer_confirmed to true to state this. Do not invent contact details. market "maldives" is for delivery in the Maldives (use product ids from search_products where possible); "brazil_export" is for container orders from Brazil.

buyer_confirmed.description: true only if the buyer reviewed these details and asked you to send them.

company.description: Resort, hotel, restaurant or importing company.

delivery_date.description: Wanted delivery date or frequency. Optional.

delivery_location.description: Resort or island, or destination port for exports. Optional.

product.description: Product name as the buyer would say it.

product_id.description: id from search_products, or sku from list_brazil_export_offers. Optional.

message.description: Anything else the buyer wants to say. Optional.

phone.description: Phone or WhatsApp with country code. Optional.

name: request_quotation
title: Send a quotation request
